item.title: azure: Retirement: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 will end on September 1, 2027
item.description:
Azure App Service will end support for Java 8, 11, and 17 on September 1, 2027. Apps will keep running, but security updates and customer support for those Java versions will stop.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.27.0 adds support for Linux ARM64
item.description:
CodeQL 2.27.0 is available on Linux ARM64. The release also adds a new Rust security query, expands framework coverage for Java/Kotlin and C#, and includes analysis accuracy improvements across multiple languages.

  • Source: GitHub
